---
title: "What changed: edited papers"
---

This is the example workspace's fixed example of edits to a literature review and a separate LaTeX paper. The release build makes it from `scripts/demo-edits.patch` and adds a link below after validating the report. The rendered snapshot is published to Pages and is never committed.

<!-- template-demo-report -->

When the report has not been built, this page describes the example only. To see changes to your own project, open **What changed** in your pull request's preview comment. You can remove this example page and its navigation entries when replacing the sample content.

Check these views:

1. **A small literature review:** Quarto HTML marks the revised Transformer claim, the added BERT claim, and the new reference. `lit-review/index.qmd` is its editable source.
2. **Paper:** the separate `paper/main.tex` has an HTML diff and a PDF diff. Look for the added citation and equation, the revised sentence, and the changed figure caption. Both paths use `references.bib`.
